IDQ20840
Australian Government Bureau of Meteorology

Final Flood Warning for the Lower Moonie River

Issued at 10:18 am AEST on Tuesday 3 November 2026
Flood Warning Number: 11


NINDIGULLY BELOW MINOR FLOOD LEVEL, NO FURTHER FLOODING EXPECTED

The Moonie River at Nindigully has fallen below the minor flood level and is expected to
continue easing. No further flooding is expected.

Further showers and storms remain possible during Tuesday, however these are not expected
to cause additional flooding at this stage. The situation will be monitored and warnings
will restart if required.

Moonie River downstream of Flinton:
No further flooding is expected along the Moonie River downstream of Flinton.

The Moonie River at Nindigully is currently at 2.15 m and steady, below the minor flood
level. The Moonie River at Nindigully is expected to continue easing and remain below the
minor flood level (2.20 m).

Safety Advice:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous.
* Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways.
* Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads.
* Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay
informed.
* For local emergency management warnings and advice visit
www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.

For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening
emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

Next issue:
This is a final warning. No further warnings will be issued for this event.
